'''Chopper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] criminal and a member of the notorious gang known as the [[Fondor Five]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the gang was spotted operating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Because of the gang's violent tendencies, the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] placed a high [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their heads. The bounty was eventually collected after all five gang members were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a firefight in the [[Fartrader Lounge]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chopper appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the five targets of the Heroic mission "Republic's Most Wanted".<ref name="TOR" />
